mapper.select: SELECT /* homes.common.mapper.CommonMapper.selectSidoCode 시도지역조회 */ SDCODE, AR_FULL_NM AS ARNAME FROM TB_CM_COAREACODE A WHERE SDCODE = #{sdcode} AND ARLEVEL = 1 AND USE_YN = 'Y'
SELECT /* homes.common.mapper.CommonMapper.selectSggCode 시군구지역조회 */ SDCODE, SGGCODE , ARNAME FROM TB_CM_COAREACODE A WHERE SDCODE = #{sdcode} AND ARLEVEL = 2 AND USE_YN = 'Y'

SELECT /* homes.common.mapper.CommonMapper.selectArCode 지역조회 */ AREACODE, ARCODE, LEGCODE, AR_FULL_NM, ARNAME, SDCODE, SGGCODE , CONCAT(EMDCODE, RICODE) AS EMDCODE , ( SELECT AR_FULL_NM FROM TB_CM_COAREACODE WHERE SDCODE = A.SDCODE AND ARLEVEL = 1 AND USE_YN = 'Y' ) AS SDNAME , ( SELECT ARNAME FROM TB_CM_COAREACODE WHERE SDCODE = A.SDCODE AND SGGCODE = A.SGGCODE AND ARLEVEL = 2 AND USE_YN = 'Y' ) AS SGGNAME , ( SELECT ARNAME FROM TB_CM_COAREACODE WHERE SDCODE = A.SDCODE AND SGGCODE = A.SGGCODE AND EMDCODE = A.EMDCODE AND ARLEVEL = 3 AND USE_YN = 'Y' ) AS EMDNAME FROM TB_CM_COAREACODE A WHERE AREACODE = #{areacode} AND ARLEVEL = 3 AND USE_YN = 'Y'
SELECT /* homes.common.mapper.CommonMapper.selectSidoList 시도목록 조회 */ AREACODE, ARCODE, SDCODE, AR_FULL_NM AS ARNAME FROM TB_CM_COAREACODE A WHERE ARLEVEL = 1 AND USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY ORDR ASC

SELECT /* homes.common.mapper.CommonMapper.selectSggList 시군구 조회 */ AREACODE, SDCODE , ( SELECT AR_FULL_NM FROM TB_CM_COAREACODE WHERE SDCODE = A.SDCODE AND ARLEVEL = 1 AND USE_YN = 'Y' ) AS SDNAME , ARCODE , ARNAME FROM TB_CM_COAREACODE A WHERE SDCODE = #{sdcode} AND ARLEVEL = 2 AND USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY AREACODE ASC

SELECT /* homes.common.mapper.CommonMapper.selectEmdList 읍면동 조회 */ AREACODE , SDCODE , ( SELECT AR_FULL_NM FROM TB_CM_COAREACODE WHERE SDCODE = A.SDCODE AND ARLEVEL = 1 AND USE_YN = 'Y' ) AS SDNAME , ARCODE AS SGGCODE , ( SELECT ARNAME FROM TB_CM_COAREACODE WHERE ARCODE = A.ARCODE AND ARLEVEL = 2 AND USE_YN = 'Y' ) AS SGGNAME , ARCODE , LEGCODE , ARNAME FROM TB_CM_COAREACODE A WHERE ARCODE = #{arcode} AND ARLEVEL = 3 AND USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY AREACODE ASC
SELECT /* homes.common.mapper.CommonMappe.getLastfileno */ MAX(FILENO) AS FILENO FROM TB_CM_COMMFILE WHERE USERNO = #{userno}

SELECT /* homes.common.mapper.CommonMappe.commonMap */ MXTR_COMM_CD AS COMMCD , CODE_NM AS CODENM FROM TB_CM_COMMCODE WHERE GRP_CD = #{grpcd} AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND UPPER_CD IS NOT NULL AND UPPER_CD != '' ORDER BY CD_ORDR
